description: Poll a request from phaedo_sign_mandate. Pass the request_id AND the mandate that call returned. Returns signed + the mandate carrying the verified signature once the subject signs, refused if they declined, pending while you should keep waiting, or expired once the window lapsed. A signed result is verified against the subject's published signing key before it is returned.
name: phaedo_sign_status
title: Check whether the subject has signed the mandate
